Title: Info
Text:
In 4D v16, the Web Server can be run in preemptive mode. All commands of the Web Server and HTTP Client themes are thread-safe.

A new database setting "Use preemptive processes" allows the Web Server to run with preemptive processes.

Title: Steps to follow
Text:
1. Type "http://127.0.0.1/test.html" in a browser.
2. Click on the "Preemptive processes" or "Cooperative processes" button to choose the mode.
3. Reload the web page.

Title: Result
Text:
This benchmark was executed on a computer with 4 cores.


Cooperative: 10.8 s
Preemptive: 3.7 s
